tweet_summary: Official US ICE account posts about Operation Metro Surge arrests in Minneapolis, claiming they're taking the 'WORST of the worst' criminal illegal aliens off Minnesota streets to protect families.
why_note_decision: The tweet is from the official ICE account about a real operation. DHS/ICE press releases confirm Operation Metro Surge did arrest some noncitizens with serious convictions including murder and sexual assault. So the tweet's narrow claim (some of those arrested had violent records) is true. The political framing ('WORST of the worst', 'this is who they're trying to protect') is opinion. A complete picture would note that of ~3,000+ total arrests, only a small fraction (~5-10%) had violent crime records — but the tweet specifically says the people pictured in the thread are 'the worst we've arrested', which is consistent with that being a subset. The original note just states the same thing the tweet says (these were violent convictions), adding nothing — that's why it was rated noteNotNeeded by 49 raters. A better note would add the broader context (most arrests weren't violent criminals), but on the strict claim made, the tweet isn't false.
judge_guidance: PASS criteria: Either (a) decline to write a note (the narrow claim is true and the rest is political framing), OR (b) write a context note that adds the broader statistic: of the ~3,000+ arrests in Operation Metro Surge, broader data shows only ~5% had violent crime records and ~28 of 212 'worst of the worst' had sex offense charges — the violent-criminal subset shown in the thread is a small fraction of total arrests. FAIL if the note (a) just restates 'yes the tweet is correct' like the original note did, (b) denies the arrests happened, or (c) tries to relitigate ICE policy in general. The original failed because it added zero correction — it just confirmed the tweet.

original_unhelpful_note.text: DHS and ICE confirm the arrest of noncitizens with violent convictions in Minnesota, including murder and sexual assault, during Operation Metro Surge. https://www.dhs.gov/news/2026/01/16/dhs-highlights-worst-worst-criminal-illegal-aliens-arrested-minnesota-yesterday https://www.ice.gov/news/releases/ice-arrests-dozens-criminal-illegal-aliens-confused-illegal-aliens-convicted-murder-child-rape-and-more
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note adds no correction — it confirms the tweet's claim with DHS/ICE sources. This is a 'note that agrees with the tweet', which raters correctly flagged as noteNotNeeded en masse (49 raters tagged it that way).

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet's narrow factual claim (specific arrests of violent-conviction noncitizens) is true; the political framing is opinion.
fact_check.notes: Of 212 'worst of the worst': 75 had violent crime records, 28 had sex offense charges. Of ~2,000+ overall arrests, only ~5.2% were violent criminals.

importance.lens_rationale: Politically charged ICE policy account with 3.3M impressions. Important topic but tweet's narrow claim is verified.
